items.letters-offer: Pick an employee, the offer template renders from its fields (CTC as money and in words); a blank placeholder refuses; issued text is kept as issued.
items.letters-increment: Record the revised CTC on the employee first, then issue — the letter quotes what payroll will actually pay.
items.letters-warning: Warning letter from the template, kept as the text that went out; needs employee.update only, never the salary permission.
items.letters-relieving: Relieving letter per employee, issued copies listed with print / PDF.
items.letters-nda: Confidentiality undertaking rendered from the employee; print for signature, file the signed copy under Document Tracker.
items.letters-templates: Every template in config/letters.json with its placeholders, permissions and issued count; Change wording is versioned per tenant.
items.send-message: Scope by company / branch / department / designation / team / employee with ALL, tick Email / WhatsApp / SMS, preview who resolves to an address, then queue one row per recipient and channel — no transport is configured, so nothing is sent.
items.notice-board: Notices with a validity window: current / upcoming / expired / draft; Notices::current() is what a dashboard shows.
items.messages-log: One row per recipient and channel from Send Message and Greetings, with status queued / sent / failed and the batch it belonged to.
items.greetings: Who is due a birthday or work-anniversary greeting today and this week from DOB and DOJ; the wording renders through the letter engine; Queue writes it to the Messages Log; the log below is the greetings log.
items.wa-templates: Approved WhatsApp templates (name, language, category, body with {{n}} variables) offered as a starting text on Send Message.
items.wa-settings: WhatsApp provider connection: API key, sender number, WABA id, status.
items.sms-templates: DLT-approved SMS templates with their template ids, offered on Send Message.
items.sms-settings: SMS gateway connection: provider, API URL and key, sender id, DLT entity id.
